scenes.name: login
scenes.caption: Sign-in screen — OAuth2 password grant against the FastAPI backend.
scenes.narration: Sign in to your self-hosted health records — your data stays on your machine.

scenes.name: dashboard
scenes.caption: Patient dashboard with the draggable react-grid-layout widgets.
scenes.narration: The dashboard gives every patient an at-a-glance overview — arrange the widgets however you work.

scenes.name: patients
scenes.caption: Patient list — tenant-scoped, paginated, with search.
scenes.narration: All patients in one tenant-scoped list — search, filter, and open a record.

scenes.name: patient-detail
scenes.caption: Patient detail view — demographics, timeline, and linked resources.
scenes.narration: Each patient record ties together demographics, timeline, and every linked clinical resource.

scenes.name: biomarkers
scenes.caption: Biomarker catalog — definitions, units, and reference ranges.
scenes.narration: The biomarker catalog keeps units and reference ranges consistent across every measurement.

scenes.name: documents
scenes.caption: Document list — uploaded exams/reports routed through the OCR pipeline.
scenes.narration: Upload an exam report and the OCR pipeline turns it into structured, searchable data.

scenes.name: examinations
scenes.caption: Examination list — tracking patient visits, consults, and related diagnoses.
scenes.narration: Examinations track every visit and consult with their related diagnoses.

scenes.name: examination-detail
scenes.caption: Examination detail view — structured clinical notes and linked entities.
scenes.narration: Clinical notes stay structured and linked to the entities they mention.

scenes.name: biomarker-detail
scenes.caption: Biomarker detail view — longitudinal trends and clinical significance.
scenes.narration: Biomarker values become longitudinal trends you can actually read.

scenes.name: ai-chat
scenes.caption: Agentic AI chat — tools, SSE streaming, and HITL task cards.
scenes.narration: Ask the AI assistant about your results — it answers with your data, with human-in-the-loop control.
